lines.text: Mia carried us in the final round.

data.define: To lead a team to victory with great skill.

example.text: Mia carried us in the final round.

misuse.text: Don't say 'she carried us' about a lazy teammate.
misuse.why: It praises someone who did the work.

data.l1_ex: لقد قامت ميا بـ "carry" الفريق في الجولة الأخيرة.

native.tip: “carry” = يحمل. مثال: “Mia carried us in the final round.”
